answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks by staking unique physical hardware tokens. First, an agent registers a quantum key generator sealed in cedar. Second, a network beacon verifies the token's physical entropy. Third, the agent signs data via a jade optical lattice. To create fake identities, an attacker must bear the prohibitive cost of manufacturing distinct, physically unclonable quantum tokens for each Sybil node, rendering mass identity creation economically ruinous.
